whenToUse: The header of a news or magazine site with many sections, where each section needs a preview of its latest stories.
Sites that need a date / weather strip and reader sign-in with password recovery in a dialog.
avoidWhen: Small business or SaaS sites — use Navbar.
Admin panels — use App shell and Sidebar.
a11y: Mega panels open on hover and on focus or Enter; sub-sections swap their stories on focus; Escape closes.
The search form is a search landmark; Escape closes it and returns focus to its button.
